title: Held to, in writing
summary: A two-column spec in type only: the four rules every seat works by on their own ruled rows, and beside them the deal as a short block of three terms hung on one hairline, with its own rhythm — the page's still beat between the drawing and the form.
story: Answers the visitor's second question — what is the work held to — before asking anything of them. The rules (own systems, write, diagnose out loud, no theater) are the long column; the deal (no juniors, published comp, remote-first and London-based) is the short one beside it, set as terms rather than as partners to the rules, so nothing on the sheet pretends a rule and a term are pairs. A buyer reads the same sheet as how the work on their account will be done. The one link goes to the week the work runs on, on /about.

phone: ≤1023: the deal drops under the rules and becomes a compact spec — key (112px) beside value, hairline rows — then the link stays under the rules. ≤767: each rule keeps its index beside the title (44px column) so nothing stacks needlessly; titles 22px, bodies 16px; the deal's key column narrows to 76px with 16px values; the one long link wraps at 320 instead of overflowing. Checked at 320, 390, 834, 1024, 1280: no overflow, nothing under 11px; the h2 is balanced (no orphan at 1024) and the bodies wrap pretty.

reference.borrowed: A main column and a short terms column of a different kind of thing beside it, read as one sheet.
reference.kelwin: Rebuilt as a drafting spec: the rules on ruled rows under a mono column head on a strong rule, hanging H·0n indexes, Mona display titles over 17px bodies; the deal as its own short block on one left hairline (the footer's column rule), mono keys over 20px values set close, with no row rules of its own, so its terms never sit on the rules' rows. No cards, no icons, no “Enforced” stamps, no radar.

motion: entrance: the kit's only — the ruled seam draws, the label fades, the heading rises. The sheet itself is still (the story map's still beat).

notes: Height 1115px at 1440. Type only, by design: the header carries the page's drawing and the bench section its one moment. The rules are an ol of h3 titles; the deal is an aside with its own h3 and a dl of three terms. “The rules” column head is aria-hidden (the h2 already says it). Duplicates removed by default (each flagged for the founder): the lede's “nobody learns on a client’s budget” clause (kept in the deal's Juniors row, its [K] source), the deal's Writing row (H·02 says it), and H·02's “best writers here” sentence (staff the firm doesn't have).
